title: Hussain Deen-e-Paiyambar Bacha Ke Dum Lenge
body:
Hussain Deen-e-Paiyambar Bacha Ke Dum Lenge
Sitam Garou Ke Kaleje Hila Ke Dum Lenge
1.Yeh Mana Aun-o-Mohd Bhot Hi Pyase Hai Magar Yeh Hyder-e-Karrar Ke Nawase Hai
Sipah-e-Shaam Ku Ghar Tak Bhaaga Ke Dum Lenge
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Yeh Kehraha Hai Sakina Tere Chacha Ka Mizaj
Durast Kardenge Pal Bhar Me Aashkiyan Ka Mazaj
Jalal-e-Fatah-e-Khaibar Dikha Ke Dum Lenge
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Hai Pukhta Apne Irade Me Noujawan Akber
Isiliye Toh Raghadhte Hai Aedhiya Akber
Nishan-e-Daulat-e-Fasaq Meeta Ke Dum Lenge
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Yeh Aur Baat Hai Kamsin Hai Chal Nahin Sakte Magar Irade Bhi Asghar Ke Tal Nahin Sakte
Yeh Gheware Se Maqtal Me Jaake Dum Lenge
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Hussain Wada-e-Teflee Nibhane Wale Hai
Khuda Ki Rah Me Gardan Kaate Wale Hai
Ghamou Se Chur Hai Jannat Me Jaake Dum Lenge
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Har Ek Dil Me Basainge Sheh Ka Gham Fakhri
Har Ek Ghar Me Sajaienge Yeh Alam Fakhri
Hussain Wale Hai Duniya Pe Chahe Dum Lenge
